'''Forward/Rear Projecting XoLyyn Shields''', also known as '''XoLyyn shielding''', was utilized by the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="Stele">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Forward/Rear Projecting XoLyyn Shields were mentioned in ''[[The Stele Chronicles]]'', a booklet included in the box for the [[1994]] [[Totally Games]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].<ref name="Stele" />
